title: The suitcase bar for dry states
summary: Fats carried a case of liquor for towns in dry states like West Virginia where nothing could be bought.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: It is true that he carried a suitcase with him that was -- had a complete bar, that could just open up?

Well yes, because a lot of places we went to, I think in West Virginia places, dry states, you know, a lot of -- they didn't sell anything. So if he didn't carry it, you didn't have anything to drink.

You know. So he sits on the stand, and once in a while you see somebody go over to this case and pick it up and walk off in the dark behind the curtain, and then they (unintelligible) come and sit it down, you know. So naturally that created a -- what's in that bag that Fats carries? You know.
And if he didn't have it, then of course you couldn't buy it. That's the law. You know. And where you could buy it it was no trouble.
